_doc: OrbySystems' import CSV: the format a person converts their own records
to, so OrbySystems can read them into a spending or investment project.
One file per kind. A file is recognised by its header: the required
columns, any of the optional ones, and nothing else, named exactly as
here. IMPORT-CSV.md is the human-readable copy of this file; the
read it, and OrbySystems' Records Converter quotes it in the prompt it
writes. Comma-separated, UTF-8, one header row, one row per record.

transactions.name: orbysystems-transactions.csv
transactions.about: Every transaction of bank, credit-card and similar accounts: what came in and what went out.

columns.name: date
columns.about: The day of the transaction, as YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: description
columns.about: The payee or memo, as the records have it. Never empty.

columns.name: amount
columns.about: Negative when money left the account (the person is poorer), positive when it came in. On a credit card a purchase is negative and a payment to the card positive. Plain number: a dot for decimals, no currency symbol, no thousands separators.

columns.name: account_type
columns.about: What kind of account the transaction belongs to.

columns.name: institution
columns.about: The bank or card issuer that holds the account, e.g. Chase.

columns.name: account_last4
columns.about: The last four digits of the account's number. Any four digits the person chooses for an account with none.

columns.name: account_name
columns.about: The person's own name for the account, e.g. Joint checking.

columns.name: balance
columns.about: The account's balance after the transaction, or empty.

columns.name: currency
columns.about: The account's currency as a three-letter ISO code, e.g. EUR. Empty for US dollars.

investment_transactions.name: orbysystems-investment-transactions.csv
investment_transactions.about: Every transaction of brokerage, retirement and similar investment accounts: trades, income, fees and money moving in or out.

columns.name: date
columns.about: The trade or settlement day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: description
columns.about: What the records say happened, e.g. Bought 10 VTI. Never empty.

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.about: What kind of transaction it is. A reinvested dividend is two rows: the dividend, then a buy. internal_transfer is money or shares moving between two of the person's own accounts.

columns.name: amount
columns.about: The cash the transaction moved in the account: negative when cash left it (a buy, a fee, a withdrawal), positive when cash came in (a sale, a dividend, a deposit). 0 when no cash moved, e.g. shares transferred in.

columns.name: symbol
columns.about: The security's ticker, e.g. VTI. Empty for a row that is cash only.

columns.name: quantity
columns.about: How many shares or units: never negative for a buy, a sale or income. For shares moving with no cash (transfer_in, transfer_out, internal_transfer), negative when they left the account.

columns.name: price
columns.about: The price per share or unit.

columns.name: fees
columns.about: Commissions and fees charged on the transaction, as a positive number.

columns.name: account_type
columns.about: What kind of account the transaction belongs to.

columns.name: institution
columns.about: The broker or plan provider that holds the account, e.g. Fidelity.

columns.name: account_last4
columns.about: The last four digits of the account's number. Any four digits the person chooses for an account with none.

columns.name: account_name
columns.about: The person's own name for the account, e.g. Work 401(k).

columns.name: currency
columns.about: The account's currency as a three-letter ISO code, e.g. EUR. Empty for US dollars.

holdings.name: orbysystems-holdings.csv
holdings.about: What investment accounts held, as of one day or several: one row per security per account per day.

columns.name: as_of
columns.about: The day the holding is as of, as YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: symbol
columns.about: The security's ticker, e.g. VTI. CASH for cash held in the account.

columns.name: quantity
columns.about: How many shares or units were held; for CASH, the amount of cash.

columns.name: description
columns.about: The security's name, e.g. Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF.

columns.name: price
columns.about: The price per share or unit on that day.

columns.name: market_value
columns.about: What the holding was worth on that day.

columns.name: cost_basis
columns.about: What the holding cost in all.

columns.name: account_type
columns.about: What kind of account holds it.

columns.name: institution
columns.about: The broker or plan provider that holds the account, e.g. Fidelity.

columns.name: account_last4
columns.about: The last four digits of the account's number. Any four digits the person chooses for an account with none.

columns.name: account_name
columns.about: The person's own name for the account, e.g. Work 401(k).

columns.name: currency
columns.about: The account's currency as a three-letter ISO code, e.g. EUR. Empty for US dollars.
